mainEntity.name: How much does a Renault Clio Renaultsport engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Renault Clio Renaultsport engine replacement typically costs £1,500-£3,500 for a reconditioned F4R unit supply-only, with used engines from £800-£2,000. Fitting adds approximately 10-14 hours of labour at specialist rates. Main dealer prices are typically 40-60% higher. The exact cost depends on your engine code - F4R 830 (197) or F4R 832 (200) - and the extent of any auxiliary damage.

mainEntity.name: What is the cambelt interval on a Clio Renaultsport 197/200?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cambelt and auxiliary belt must be replaced every 72,000 miles or five years - whichever comes sooner. The F4R engine is very sensitive to cam timing, and botched cambelt replacements are common. Always use a Renaultsport specialist, not a main dealer, for this job. Expect to pay around £500 at a specialist or £850+ at a dealer.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of a failing gearbox on a Clio 197/200?

acceptedAnswer.text: The TL4 six-speed gearbox suffers from premature synchromesh wear, affecting third and fourth gears most commonly. Signs include crunching or graunching when changing gear, difficulty engaging gears, and a 'thunk' when selecting gears. Early 197s (2006-2007) are most at risk. If you hear any of these symptoms, budget for a gearbox rebuild (£800-£1,500) or replacement (£1,000-£2,000).

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Clio Renaultsport?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on your Clio RS's overall condition and value. A Renault Clio Renaultsport 197 is typically worth £5,000-£10,000, while the 200 commands £8,000-£15,000. A reconditioned engine supply and fit costs £2,500-£5,000. For a cherished Clio RS, replacement is usually worthwhile, especially with a 12-month warranty. For examples with significant body or suspension wear, evaluate carefully.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Clio Renaultsport engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Renault Clio Renaultsport engine replacement typically takes 10-14 hours of labour at a specialist workshop. Allow 3-5 working days for the full supply-and-fit process, including delivery of the replacement unit. Specialists often offer faster turnaround than main dealers due to their focus on these models.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the 197 and 200 engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both use the same 1,998cc F4R engine family. The 197 (F4R 830) produces 197bhp at 7,250rpm. The 200 (F4R 832) produces 200bhp at 7,100rpm with improved head casting and ECU mapping. The 200 also offers 20% more low-end torque and improved drivability. The 197 was produced from 2006-2009; the 200 from 2009-2012.

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my Clio 197 engine with a 200 engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the F4R 830 (197) and F4R 832 (200) are interchangeable, but it requires ECU reprogramming to match the different mapping. The engine mounts, gearbox and ancillaries are the same. Always use a Renaultsport specialist for the swap to ensure correct ECU calibration and immobiliser pairing. The 200 engine offers slightly more power and better low-end torque.

mainEntity.name: What warranty comes with a reconditioned Clio Renaultsport engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every reconditioned Renault Clio Renaultsport F4R engine supplied through EnginesMarket carries a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. Used engines typically come with a shorter warranty (30-90 days) depending on the supplier - always confirm the warranty terms before purchasing. Rebuilt engines also include upgraded components where applicable, addressing the original failure points.

historyTimeline.h2: Renault Clio Renaultsport 197 / 200 - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The Renault Clio Renaultsport 197 and 200 are the third-generation hot hatches from Renault's performance division, launched in 2006 and facelifted in 2009. Powered by a naturally aspirated 2.0-litre 16v F4R engine - a development of the unit used in the Clio 172/182 and Megane RS - these cars delivered fizzy, high-revving performance that made them icons of the hot hatch class.

milestones.description: Clio Renaultsport 197 launched, F4R 830 engine, 197bhp (194bhp in some markets) at 7,250rpm, 215Nm torque
F1 Team R27 special edition introduced, celebrating Renault's F1 success; first Cup chassis on 197
Cup chassis offered as £400 option on regular 197s
TL4 gearbox revised with taller sixth gear
Facelift: Clio Renaultsport 200 replaces 197, F4R 832 engine, 200bhp at 7,100rpm, 215Nm torque, improved low-end torque
200 Cup introduced with quicker steering rack

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every F4R engine fitted to the Renault Clio Renaultsport 197 and 200 is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: Renault Clio Renaultsport 197 / 200 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Renault Clio Renaultsport's F4R engine is a high-revving naturally aspirated 2.0-litre four-cylinder. It's nigh on unburstable when properly maintained - but it's also sensitive to servicing, particularly cambelt changes. The TL4 six-speed gearbox is the Clio RS's Achilles' heel, with synchromesh wear a well-documented issue. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components and a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Cambelt & Auxiliary Belt Failure - Why the F4R Engine Demands Specialist Attention
problems.rootCause: The F4R engine uses a cambelt, not a chain. The belt must be replaced every 72,000 miles or five years. The engine is highly sensitive to cam timing - numerous botched cambelt replacements have been reported by Renaultsport specialists. If the belt fails, the interference engine suffers catastrophic valve and piston damage.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Cambelt kit, auxiliary belt, tensioners, water pump
repairOptions.longevity: Essential every 72k miles or 5 years - use a specialist, not a dealer

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Cambelt kit + dephaser pulley, water pump
repairOptions.longevity: If dephaser is noisy or VVT issues present
If cambelt has snapped causing internal damage - specialist rebuild often cheaper than dealer

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Renault Clio Renaultsport 197 (2006-2009) is worth approximately £5,000-£10,000, while the 200 (2009-2012) commands £8,000-£15,000. A cambelt service (£500-£850) is a routine maintenance cost that every RS owner should budget for. If the belt has snapped, full replacement cost (£2,500-£5,000) may approach 30-50% of the vehicle's value - still usually worthwhile on a cherished example.
problems.recommendation: Never skimp on the cambelt. Use a Renaultsport specialist - not a main dealer - for the cambelt service. Specialists understand the F4R's timing sensitivity and have the correct tools. If you're buying a Clio RS, check the cambelt history: if it's overdue, budget £500+ immediately. Prevention costs £500-£850; a snapped belt costs £2,500+ for a replacement engine.

problems.h4: TL4 Gearbox Synchromesh Wear - The Achilles' Heel of the Clio RS
problems.rootCause: The TL4 six-speed manual gearbox suffers from premature synchromesh wear, affecting third and fourth gears most commonly, but some owners report second gear issues too. Many early gearboxes were replaced under warranty, with some failing at just 25,000 miles. The fault was remedied from late 2007 onwards.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Strip gearbox, replace worn synchros, reassemble
repairOptions.longevity: If only synchros are worn - cost-effective if caught early
If synchro wear has caused further damage - common solution
If both engine and gearbox have failed - rare but possible on track cars

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A gearbox rebuild (£800-£1,500) is a significant but manageable cost on a Clio RS worth £5,000-£15,000. Full gearbox replacement (£1,000-£2,000) is still worthwhile on most examples. On sub-£5,000 early 197s, weigh the cost carefully against the car's overall condition.
problems.recommendation: When test driving a Clio RS, check all gears slot home cleanly with no crunches or graunches. Pay particular attention to third and fourth gears. If there's any crunching, budget for a gearbox rebuild or replacement. Early 197s (2006-2007) are most at risk - many have already been replaced under warranty. Specialist gearbox rebuilds are often more cost-effective than dealer replacements.

problems.group: Exhaust Manifold Cracking & Engine Mount Failure
problems.h4: Exhaust Manifold Cracking & Engine Mount Failure
problems.rootCause: The exhaust manifold is known to crack on both 197 and 200 models. The engine mounts can also fail prematurely due to the extra stress of track use and the engine's high-revving nature. A cracked manifold can cause exhaust leaks, reduced performance and MOT failure.

repairOptions.longevity: If cracked - common on higher-mileage examples
If mounts are worn - often needed on track cars
Only if manifold cracking has caused other issues

problems.vehicleValueCheck: Manifold replacement (£400-£800) is a worthwhile investment on a Clio RS worth £5,000-£15,000. If the manifold is cracked and the car is otherwise sound, the repair is cost-effective.
problems.recommendation: Inspect the exhaust manifold for cracks during routine servicing. If you notice a ticking or blowing noise from the engine bay, or a drop in performance, have the manifold checked. Specialist replacement is significantly cheaper than dealer prices.
